description: This file defines a 'ProductGrid' UI component using LightningJS framework. It manages layout, rendering of product cards in a grid, and contains associated methods and state.

classes.name: ProductGrid
classes.description: A LightningJS component that displays a grid of products, handling layout and rendering of individual ProductCard components.

methods.name: $flatIndex
methods.description: Calculates the index in the flat products array based on row and column indices.

methods.name: $rowY
methods.description: Computes the y-coordinate for a given row index in the grid layout.

methods.name: $colX
methods.description: Computes the x-coordinate for a given column index in the grid layout.
